title: Sword Against the Seven-Stars - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Sword Against the Seven-Stars trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Sword Against the Seven-Stars phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Seven-Stars are a formation rather than a single enemy, so the fight is about reading several attackers at once. See the disambiguation page for what the name refers to in each context.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Defeat the Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 10 of 36 on the list - before it The Lion's Spirit Lives On · after it Crossroads of Blood. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
